Package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.buildings

package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.buildings
Building Effects. Each class implements IEffect of BuildingCard and reacts to a specific phase (purchase, end of turn, event, end of game), e.g., event discounts, aura bonuses by character type, or extra picks.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BuildingDoubleInventor
    Building effect: rewards with bonus food the completion of a pair of inventors of the same level.
    BuildingEndgameAura
    Building effect: credits a fixed aura bonus during the endgame scoring.
